verdict.rationale: Elicit's first-party docs describe a dedicated Systematic Reviews workflow. It runs from a Setup page through title/abstract screening and an automated full-text screening step to column-based data extraction from body text and tables, with screening criteria and extraction parameters controllable via the UI and API. Screening recommendation and extraction tables can be exported, and papers can be imported via RIS/BIB/Zotero for screening at scale. Elicit's own guidance that about 90% of output is accurate and needs close checking means consistency is not guaranteed without human review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the screening/extraction workflow's accuracy and consistency, and detail on how criteria are applied uniformly across large paper sets.
